poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE ECHO OF WATER WHERE THE FIRE ONCE BURNED SO BRIGHT.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: REMEMBERING WHEN WE WERE CLOSE, BUT TIME ALWAYS FLOWS APART.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: WE ARE ONLY GHOSTS IN THIS QUIET EXPANSION.
sonnetLines: The current fades to dust and grit,
Where laughter once was freely lit.
A phantom sweetness on the tongue,
A song that should have never sung.
We built our world too fast, too high,
Beneath a vast and changing sky.
From promises we failed to keep.
The edges blur with fading light,
Just echoes where the warmth resided,
Of moments that refused to stay,
And drifted far, and slipped away.
